dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そして、悪い竜の王は言いました」
dialogues.en: "...And with his final breath, the evil dragon king roared."
dialogues.text: "...And with his final breath, the evil dragon king roared."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「『……また会うこともあろう。儂は何度でも
　甦ってみせる。貴様ら人間に悪の心がある限
　り儂は不滅なのだ。ふははははははぁ〜』」
dialogues.en:
"...We will meet again. As long as there is evil in the
hearts of you filthy humans, I will be immortal.
Wahahahahaha!"
dialogues.text:
"...We will meet again. As long as there is evil in the
hearts of you filthy humans, I will be immortal.
Wahahahahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の高笑い……もとい、教科書を朗読する音
夢の声が響きわたる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's loud, evil laughter... was actually coming from a
textbook that she was reciting out loud.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's loud, evil laughter... was actually coming from a
textbook that she was reciting out loud.

dialogues.jp: （なんか凄い内容の物語だな）
こんなの教科書に載せるなよ……。
dialogues.en: They placed this sort of thing in a textbook...
dialogues.text: They placed this sort of thing in a textbook...

dialogues.en: What kind of trickery are they up to now?
dialogues.text: What kind of trickery are they up to now?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「『何度復活しても必ず倒してやる。
　　悪魔め！　世界の平和は必ず守るぞ！』」
dialogues.en:
"No matter how many times you come back, we'd defeat you
everytime, you demon! To protect the peace of the world!"
dialogues.text:
"No matter how many times you come back, we'd defeat you
everytime, you demon! To protect the peace of the world!"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、いいか。俺は音夢の朗読に耳をかたむけ
る。
dialogues.en:
Well, whatever. I continue to listen attentively to Nemu's
recital.
dialogues.text:
Well, whatever. I continue to listen attentively to Nemu's
recital.

dialogues.jp:
（他人の朗読ってのはいいよな。自分で読まな
　くてすむし）
dialogues.en:
"(Good that someone else is reciting it. I wouldn't be able
to finish it myself, probably.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Good that someone else is reciting it. I wouldn't be able
to finish it myself, probably.)"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「戦士は、剣を掲げ、誓いました」
dialogues.en: "The fighters, lifting their swords in the air, made a vow."
dialogues.text: "The fighters, lifting their swords in the air, made a vow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「たとえ、竜の王が復活したとしても、自分や、
　自分の子孫が未来永劫、この土地を守ってみ
　せると」
dialogues.en:
"That no matter how many times the dragon king resurrected,
they, and their descendants, will always defeat it.
dialogues.text:
"That no matter how many times the dragon king resurrected,
they, and their descendants, will always defeat it.

dialogues.jp:
ものすごい内容の物語が、教科書に載っている。
悪、竜の王、復活、正義――
dialogues.en:
There was a surprisingly good story hidden within the
textbook. Evil, dragon king, resurrection, justice--
dialogues.text:
There was a surprisingly good story hidden within the
textbook. Evil, dragon king, resurrection, justice--
